_README: CobblemonMikeSkills — Spawn Table
Edit this file to customise encounters. Reload in-game with:
/pokeskill config → Reload Tables
A read-only backup of the original defaults is always kept in the
defaults/ sub-folder next to this file.
FILE STRUCTURE
Top-level keys are biome selectors (e.g. "is_forest", "is_desert", "any").
The key "any" matches every biome and is merged with biome-specific groups.
Each key maps to an ARRAY of Spawn Groups.
SPAWN GROUP FIELDS
rarity      Display label only (COMMON | UNCOMMON | RARE | VERY_RARE | ULTRA_RARE | LEGENDARY).
Does not affect logic — purely cosmetic in GUIs and logs.
weight      Relative selection probability for this group vs. other eligible groups.
Higher = more likely to be chosen. Groups are NOT cumulative.
Exactly ONE group is selected per encounter roll.
Recommended ranges: COMMON=60 | UNCOMMON=25 | RARE=15 | EPIC=10 | LEGENDARY=0.2
conditions  All fields are optional. Omitting a field means 'no restriction'.
rewards     Array of possible rewards inside this group. One reward is picked
via its own weighted random among the group's entries.
CONDITIONS FIELDS (all optional)
minSkillLevel / maxSkillLevel   Player skill level required (integer, 0–100).
minWaterPool  / maxWaterPool    Adjacent water blocks at the bobber (fishing only).
blockMinedAny                   Array of block registry keys (digging only).
Example: ["minecraft:gravel", "minecraft:red_sand"]
Empty array = any block accepted.
weather       "clear" | "raining" | "thundering"   ("raining" also matches thundering)
timeOfDay     "day" | "night"
minY / maxY   Y-coordinate of the action (bobber for fishing, target block for dig/cut).
minExcavationScore / maxExcavationScore   Cumulative score from the excavation action.
minAttentionRequired   Minimum TypeAttention value; use for sustained-play gating.
dimension     Full registry key, e.g. "minecraft:overworld" or "minecraft:the_nether".
maxLightLevel Light level ceiling (0-15). Default 15 = no restriction.
Set to e.g. 7 to restrict this group to dark areas.
REWARD TYPES
type: "pokemon"
pokemon    Cobblemon species name (e.g. "magikarp", "charizard").
minLevel / maxLevel   Spawn level range (integers).
nbt        Extra Cobblemon property tokens appended to the property string.
Supports: form, ability, held_item, nature, gender, moves, etc.
Example: "form=alola ability=snow_warning held_item=oran_berry"
weight     Relative probability within this group's reward pool.
type: "mob"
entityId   Full entity registry key — vanilla OR any installed mod.
Example: "minecraft:zombie"  |  "alexsmobs:grizzly_bear"
The entity must extend Mob (standard hostile/passive mob). Decorative
entities (boats, minecarts) are not supported.
nbt        SNBT compound applied after spawn (Health, CustomName, AI flags, etc.).
Positional / identity keys (UUID, Pos, Rotation) are stripped automatically.
Example: "{Health:80.0f,CustomName:'{\"text\":\"Boss\"}',CustomNameVisible:1b}"
weight     Relative probability within this group's reward pool.
type: "item"
item       Full item registry key — vanilla OR any installed mod.
Example: "minecraft:emerald"  |  "farmersdelight:tomato_seeds"
nbt        DataComponentPatch SNBT (Minecraft 1.21+ format) for enchantments,
custom names, lore, durability, etc.
Example: "{changed:{\"minecraft:enchantments\":{levels:{\"minecraft:sharpness\":5}}}}"
entityId   Optional bearer mob. If set, this mob spawns holding the item and
drops it at 100% chance. Accepts any Mob subclass (vanilla or modded).
minAmount / maxAmount   Stack size range (integers). Default: 1.
weight     Relative probability within this group's reward pool.
HOW TO FIND MOD REGISTRY KEYS
Items: press F3+H in-game, then hover over the item — the ID appears in the tooltip.
Mobs:  check the mod's wiki, or look in its lang/ files for entity translation keys.
The registry key is typically modid:entity_name (snake_case).
